name: smith-machine-deadlift.html
instructions:
1. Set up for the smith machine deadlift by loading the appropriate amount of weight onto the smith machine and setting the bar to the lowest setting.
2. Stand in front of the bar with your feet around shoulder width apart and halfway under the loaded bar. Your toes should be pointed straight ahead or slightly outward. Do what is comfortable for you.
3. Reach down and grab the bar with both hands using an overhand grip just outside of shoulder width. You can use an alternating grip (one over/one under) to help you lift more weight. Lifting straps can also be used to help lift more weight.
4. Drop your hips until your shins are touching the barbell. Your hips should be in the best, most natural position for leverage so you may need to raise or lower them slightly.
5. Make sure your eyes are looking ahead. Your body will follow your head so keep your head up and eyes forward!
6. Be sure to keep a straight back and never allow it to round. You are now in the starting position.
7. Focus on standing up with the bar - not pulling the bar from the floor, and lead with your head as you rise.
8. Drive with your heels and explode upward (leading with your head) as you rise.
9. As the bar rises above your knees, thrust your hips forward and contract your back by bringing your shoulder blades back.
10. Pause here for a moment and then reverse the movement by bending at the knees while slowly lowering the weight - keeping it under strict control on the descent.
11. Reset your stance if necessary and repeat for desired reps.
